title: Sketch of flying object formation and course, Budapest to Moscow (CIA report, 17 Apr 1956)
description: CIA Information Report on Hungary, "Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity," containing a typed-in sketch of a cluster of about twelve circles arranged along a diagonal line labeled "Budapest" at upper left and "Moscow" at lower right. The text states the sketch, included with a November 1955 letter from Budapest, indicates "the formation and suspected course of the above objects," and quotes the letter describing "so-called flying saucers (rockets)" with a speed of 32 thousand km per hour. The form bears classification markings, distribution boxes and handwritten notations.
